title: IEEE 802.11 Wireless LAN

source.book: Kurose & Ross, Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach 8e

keyPoints: Architecture: BSS, AP, ad hoc; channels in 2.4 GHz may overlap.
Association with passive (beacon) or active (probe) scanning.
MAC: CSMA/CA — no collision detection; DIFS, backoff, ACK after SIFS.
RTS/CTS reservation; four address fields in the 802.11 frame.
